records.name: Dockpower FI 1200W
records.primaryText:
DockPower FI redefines PC power with a docking architecture that provides installation flexibility, simplifies cable management, and offers possibilities for future upgrades.
•
Docking Power Architecture
– Separate the PSU main unit from the Dock Module for easier access in tight spaces.
•
Pre-Route, Then Dock
– Install and manage cables first, then dock and lock the power unit into place.
•
Upgrade Without Rewiring
– Keep the Dock Module and cables installed when replacing the power unit.
•
30μ Gold-Plated Dock Connection
– Durable high-current contacts paired with a secure D-ring locking mechanism.
•
Builder-Friendly Cabling
– Native 12V-2x6 with a colored H++ connector crown and low-profile modular cables for easier routing.
